title: Global solution curves in harmonic parameters, and multiplicity of solutions
summary: \[ Δu+g(u)=f(x) \s \mbox{for $x \in Ω$}, \s u=0 \s \mbox{on $\partial Ω$} \] decompose $f(x)=μ_1 \p _1+e(x)$, where $\p _1$ is the principal eigenfunction of the Laplacian with zero boundary conditions, and $e(x) \perp \p _1$ in $L^2(Ω)$, and similarly write $u(x)= ξ_1 \p _i+U (x)$, with $ U \perp \p _1$ in $L^2(Ω)$. We study properties of the solution curve $(u(x),μ_1)(ξ_1)$, and in particular its section $μ_1=μ_1(ξ_1)$, which governs the multiplicity of solutions.
